seoTitle: Lucifer Test: Which Character Are You? (11 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Lucifer test: 11 everyday questions reveal whether you're Lucifer, Chloe, Maze, Amenadiel, Linda, Dan, Ella or Eve — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the Devil himself, the detective who can't be charmed, or the demon with a heart of gold? Answer 11 everyday questions about friends, secrets and doing the right thing, and find out which Lucifer character you are.

characters.name: Lucifer Morningstar
characters.title: The Devil Himself
characters.summary: Charming, honest and always up for a good time. You do what you want, and you make it look effortless.
description: Like Lucifer, you know how to have a good time. Bored and unhappy with his life in Hell, he left his throne to run Lux, a high-end nightclub in Los Angeles.
You don't lie. Lucifer never lies, which is why he openly tells everyone he's the Devil.
You find your real purpose in the end. In the finale, Lucifer returns to Hell to help lost souls move on to Heaven.
characters.flaw: You'd rather throw a party than talk about your feelings.
characters.signature: A drink in hand, a wicked grin and a question about what you truly desire.
characters.clashReason: they'd make everything about themselves, and somehow get away with it

characters.name: Chloe Decker
characters.title: The Detective
characters.summary: Practical, determined and very hard to fool. You get the job done, and you don't fall for anyone's charm.
description: Like Chloe, you're determined and practical. She's an LAPD homicide detective, and a former actress.
You're hard to fool. Chloe is the only human who's immune to Lucifer's charm and his power to draw out people's desires.
You follow in your family's footsteps. Chloe's late father was also an LAPD officer.
characters.flaw: You find it hard to switch off, even when everyone tells you to.
characters.signature: A badge, a case file and a very sceptical look.
characters.clashReason: they'd ask for proof of everything you say

characters.name: Mazikeen
characters.title: The Demon
characters.summary: Blunt, fearless and fiercely loyal. You say exactly what you think, and you'd fight anyone for your people.
description: Like Maze, you say exactly what you think. She's a demon who served as Lucifer's head torturer in Hell, then followed him to Los Angeles.
You're loyal to the people you let in. Maze becomes close friends with Linda, and with Chloe's daughter Trixie.
You find where you belong. Maze becomes a bounty hunter, and she marries Eve.
characters.flaw: You'd rather pick a fight than admit you're hurt.
characters.signature: A pair of blades, a bounty to collect and zero patience for small talk.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you exactly what they think of you, to your face

characters.name: Amenadiel
characters.title: The Dutiful Brother
characters.summary: Calm, patient and serious about doing the right thing. You keep your promises, even while you work out what you really want.
description: Like Amenadiel, you take your duty seriously. He's Lucifer's older brother, and the eldest of all the angels.
You're still working out who you are. When Amenadiel loses his powers and his wings, he starts to question his choices.
You become what others need. Amenadiel has a son, Charlie, with Linda, joins the LAPD, and finally becomes God.
characters.flaw: You follow the rules so closely that you forget to ask what you want.
characters.signature: A calm voice, a long view of things and the power to slow down time.
characters.clashReason: they'd lecture you about doing the right thing

characters.name: Linda Martin
characters.title: The Therapist
characters.summary: Wise, caring and impossible to shock. You're the one everyone opens up to, and you always know what to ask.
description: Like Linda, you're the one people open up to. She's a Stanford-educated psychotherapist, and Lucifer's therapist.
You stay, even when it's hard. Linda is visibly shaken when Lucifer shows her his true face, but she becomes his friend.
You make room for everyone. Linda has a son with Amenadiel, and she becomes good friends with Maze.
characters.flaw: You're so busy looking after everyone else that nobody asks how you are.
characters.signature: A notepad, a patient smile and a question that gets right to the point.

characters.name: Dan Espinoza
characters.title: The Underdog
characters.summary: Hard-working, devoted and more sensitive than you let on. You try harder than anyone gives you credit for.
description: Like Dan, you try harder than people give you credit for. He's an LAPD homicide detective, and Chloe's ex-husband.
You get underestimated. Lucifer keeps calling him "Detective Douche."
You hold on to guilt, until you finally let it go. After his death, Dan's ghost works through his guilt and moves on to Heaven.
characters.flaw: You take things personally, and you hold on to guilt for far too long.
characters.signature: A badge, a bruised ego and a lot of heart.
characters.clashReason: they'd take it personally, and sulk about it for days

characters.name: Ella Lopez
characters.title: The Ray of Sunshine
characters.summary: Upbeat, brilliant and full of surprises. You light up every room, and you hug first and ask questions later.
description: Like Ella, you light up every room. She's an upbeat forensic scientist for the LAPD, from Detroit.
You're full of surprises. Ella grew up with four brothers, and has a past involving stolen cars.
You keep the faith, even when it's tested. Ella is a devout Catholic who starts to question her faith after a friend dies.
characters.flaw: You put on a brave face, even when you're struggling.
characters.signature: A lab coat, a big hug and a fun fact nobody asked for.
characters.clashReason: they'd be cheerful at you when you just want to be grumpy

characters.name: Eve
characters.title: The Thrill-Seeker
characters.summary: Passionate, impulsive and always chasing the next thrill. You throw yourself into everything, and everyone, all at once.
description: Like Eve, you crave excitement. She's the world's first woman, and Lucifer's former lover.
You go after the life you want. After an eternity with Adam, Eve grows restless and leaves Heaven to find Lucifer again.
You find yourself in the end. Eve becomes a bounty hunter with Maze, and the two of them get married.
characters.flaw: You throw yourself into things, and people, far too fast.
characters.signature: A bright smile, a wild idea and an apple you probably shouldn't eat.
characters.clashReason: they'd want to be with you all the time, and take it personally if you said no

questions.text: A friend says something's wrong, but won't tell you what. You...

options.text: Let them know you're there, and wait for them to come to you
Hug them first, and ask questions later
Drop everything and spend the whole day with them
Ask who's behind it, and offer to deal with them
Sleeping till noon, a long lunch and a party that goes until sunrise
Something you've never tried before. The wilder, the better
Helping someone out, then a quiet dinner at home
Catching up on errands, and an early night

questions.text: Your boss gives you an order you disagree with. You...

options.text: Follow it. Doing your job is what matters
Follow it, but quietly gather proof that you're right
Ignore it. Nobody tells you what to do
Grumble about it to anyone who'll listen, then do it anyway

questions.text: You catch a friend lying to you. You...

options.text: Look them in the eye until they admit the truth
Tell them exactly what you think, and stay angry for a long time
Ask why they felt they had to lie
Forgive them fast. You'd hate to lose them

questions.text: You make a mistake that really hurts someone. You...

options.text: Carry the guilt around for months
Own it, apologise, and fix it properly
Go somewhere quiet, and think about what it says about you
Insist it wasn't your fault, then secretly beat yourself up

questions.text: Your friends throw you a surprise party. You...

options.text: Scream, laugh and maybe cry a little
Act annoyed, then secretly have the best time
Feel touched. You didn't know people cared that much
Thank everyone, then stay behind to help clean up

questions.text: Someone suggests you pick up a new hobby. You...

options.text: Learn the piano, so you can play at parties
Take up kickboxing, and spar with anyone brave enough
Try five new things at once, and stick with whichever is most fun
Laugh. You barely have time to sleep

questions.text: A friend tells you a big secret that affects someone else you love. You...

options.text: Tell the person it affects. Keeping quiet would be a lie
Help your friend find the courage to tell them
Keep it, and dread the day it comes out
Try to keep it, and blurt it out within a week

questions.text: Your partner says they need some space. You...

options.text: Give it, but text a few times a day, just to check in
Give it, and wonder what you did wrong
Tell them to take all the time they want. You don't need anyone
Talk it through calmly, so you both know where you stand

questions.text: You find out your family kept a big secret from you for years. You...

options.text: Bring it up every chance you get, for years
Look into it yourself before deciding how to feel
Trust they had their reasons, even if it hurts
Call your best friend straight away, and tell them everything

questions.text: A charming new coworker insists he's literally the Devil. You...

options.text: Roll your eyes, but keep him around. He gets results
Don't trust him, and keep a very close eye on him
Assume it's a metaphor, and want to hear more
Decide he's quirky, and like him anyway
